Praveen Kumar S

Bengaluru | 9164579959 | praveen25100s@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Experienced Software Testing Professional with 3.8years of expertise in manual testing, API testing, database testing, and mobile/web application testing. Proficient in test case design, defect tracking, regression testing, and functional validation. Adept at collaborating in Agile environments to ensure high-quality software delivery and contribute to organizational success.

EXPERIENCE

3.8 years of experience in Software Testing with expertise in manual testing, API testing, database testing, and mobile/web application testing.

Proficient in Agile (Scrum) methodologies, collaborating with development teams to ensure timely and high-quality software releases.

Skilled in creating test cases, test scenarios, test plans, and test strategies for comprehensive manual testing.

Experienced in API testing using Postman, validating endpoints, data flows, status codes, and performance.

Proficient in SQL database testing, writing and executing queries for data validation and backend verification.

Conducted mobile and web application testing across multiple platforms and browsers to ensure compatibility and performance.

Familiar with non-functional testing (performance, load, security) to uphold software quality standards.

Expertise in functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and compatibility testing. • Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC, with hands-on experience in end-to-end testing workflows.

Skilled in defect tracking and reporting using Jira, managing issues from identification to closure.

Adept at generating detailed test reports and documentation, highlighting critical defects for timely resolution.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Testing: Manual Testing, API Testing (Postman), Database Testing (SQL) • Defect Management: JIRA • Application Testing: Mobile and Web Applications • Testing Types: Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, Compatibility Testing • Methodologies & Processes: Agile (Scrum), STLC, SDLC

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and communication AMC Engineering College | 2017 – 2021

Pre-University (PCME) St Joseph’s Indian Composite PU College – Bengaluru | 2015 – 2017

SSLC St Philomean’s High School – Bengaluru | 2014 – 2015

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Software Test Engineer – Bright Canyon Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. | Aug 2022 – Till date Software Analyst – Keyloop India Pvt. Ltd. | Apr 2022 – July 2022

PROJECTS

Project – 1:

➢ Project name ➢ Client ➢ Role ➢ Technologies Web Testing

Classroom - Codingo Club Private Limited - Manual and API Tester - Manual Testing, API Testing (Postman), SQL, Mobile Testing,

Aptipro.ai is an innovative EdTech platform designed to enhance learning through personalized assessments, interactive learning modules, and real-time progress tracking. The platform supports both mobile and web applications, ensuring learning accessibility across devices. It enables content creators to design, publish, and sell courses and includes a classroom feature for conducting live tests.

Roles and Responsibilities:

➢ Performed manual testing on web and mobile applications, ensuring proper

functionality, usability, and cross-platform compatibility.

➢ Conducted API testing using Postman, validating data flows, API endpoints,

error handling, and performance.

➢ Executed SQL-based database testing to ensure data integrity, consistency, and

validation, with a focus on data migration and backend processes.

➢ Involved in functional testing, regression testing, and UI/UX testing to ensure

a seamless and optimal user experience.

➢ Collaborated within Agile sprint cycles, participating in daily stand-ups,

sprint planning, defect resolution, and retrospective meetings to ensure efficient and timely software delivery.

➢ Utilized JIRA for defect tracking, test case execution, and progress monitoring. ➢ Validated end-to-end integration workflows to ensure seamless functionality and integration across multiple platform modules.

Project – 2:

➢ Client ➢ Role ➢ Industry

Bayview - Manual and API Tester - Mortgage Loan Servicing

Bayview is a comprehensive Loan origination and mortgage processing platform designed to streamline and digitize the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle. The system facilitates automated loan underwriting, document verification, Eligibility checks, and Workflow- based loan

approvals. It enables financial institutions to reduce manual effort, minimize errors, accelerate approval timelines, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

Roles and Responsibilities:

➢ Created and validated orders via REST APIs for testing various business

scenarios

➢ Manually tested billing invoices as per business requirements to

ensure accurate and compliant billing

➢ Handled multiple change requests (CRs) and performed regression

testing across key modules

➢ Worked closely with cross-functional teams to align test coverage with

business workflows and priorities

➢ Actively participated in Test Plan meetings, collaborating with QA Leads and Business Analysts to define and finalize the testing approach.

➢ Designed and executed test cases for functional testing, ensuring all system

requirements were accurately validated.

➢ Conducted manual testing and API testing to verify system functionality,

performance, and reliability.

➢ Performed multiple types of testing including functional testing, smoke testing, sanity testing, system testing, regression testing, and retesting to ensure product quality throughout various development phases. ➢ Debugged and executed test cases, analyzed results, and identified

defects to ensure optimal application performance.

➢ Conducted cross-browser compatibility testing on platforms like Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge, ensuring a consistent user experience.

➢ Managed the bug lifecycle using JIRA, including defect identification,

tracking, and collaborating with developers for resolution.

➢ Documented and communicated testing progress, bug reports, and

enhancements to ensure alignment and clarity among cross-functional teams.

DECLARATION

I hereby declare that the information provided above is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.

(Bengaluru)

(Praveen)

sections.text:
EXPERIENCE
3.8 years of experience in Software Testing with expertise in manual testing, API testing, database testing, and mobile/web application testing.
Proficient in Agile (Scrum) methodologies, collaborating with development teams to ensure timely and high-quality software releases.
Skilled in creating test cases, test scenarios, test plans, and test strategies for comprehensive manual testing.
Experienced in API testing using Postman, validating endpoints, data flows, status codes, and performance.
Proficient in SQL database testing, writing and executing queries for data validation and backend verification.
Conducted mobile and web application testing across multiple platforms and browsers to ensure compatibility and performance.
Familiar with non-functional testing (performance, load, security) to uphold software quality standards.
Expertise in functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and compatibility testing. • Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC, with hands-on experience in end-to-end testing workflows.
Skilled in defect tracking and reporting using Jira, managing issues from identification to closure.
Adept at generating detailed test reports and documentation, highlighting critical defects for timely resolution.

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
PROJECTS
Project – 1:
➢ Project name ➢ Client ➢ Role ➢ Technologies Web Testing
Classroom - Codingo Club Private Limited - Manual and API Tester - Manual Testing, API Testing (Postman), SQL, Mobile Testing,
Aptipro.ai is an innovative EdTech platform designed to enhance learning through personalized assessments, interactive learning modules, and real-time progress tracking. The platform supports both mobile and web applications, ensuring learning accessibility across devices. It enables content creators to design, publish, and sell courses and includes a classroom feature for conducting live tests.
Roles and Responsibilities:
➢ Performed manual testing on web and mobile applications, ensuring proper
functionality, usability, and cross-platform compatibility.
➢ Conducted API testing using Postman, validating data flows, API endpoints,
error handling, and performance.
➢ Executed SQL-based database testing to ensure data integrity, consistency, and
validation, with a focus on data migration and backend processes.
➢ Involved in functional testing, regression testing, and UI/UX testing to ensure
a seamless and optimal user experience.
➢ Collaborated within Agile sprint cycles, participating in daily stand-ups,
sprint planning, defect resolution, and retrospective meetings to ensure efficient and timely software delivery.
➢ Utilized JIRA for defect tracking, test case execution, and progress monitoring. ➢ Validated end-to-end integration workflows to ensure seamless functionality and integration across multiple platform modules.
Project – 2:
➢ Client ➢ Role ➢ Industry
Bayview - Manual and API Tester - Mortgage Loan Servicing
Bayview is a comprehensive Loan origination and mortgage processing platform designed to streamline and digitize the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle. The system facilitates automated loan underwriting, document verification, Eligibility checks, and Workflow- based loan
approvals. It enables financial institutions to reduce manual effort, minimize errors, accelerate approval timelines, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
Roles and Responsibilities:
➢ Created and validated orders via REST APIs for testing various business
scenarios
➢ Manually tested billing invoices as per business requirements to
ensure accurate and compliant billing
➢ Handled multiple change requests (CRs) and performed regression
testing across key modules
➢ Worked closely with cross-functional teams to align test coverage with
business workflows and priorities
➢ Actively participated in Test Plan meetings, collaborating with QA Leads and Business Analysts to define and finalize the testing approach.
➢ Designed and executed test cases for functional testing, ensuring all system
requirements were accurately validated.
➢ Conducted manual testing and API testing to verify system functionality,
performance, and reliability.
➢ Performed multiple types of testing including functional testing, smoke testing, sanity testing, system testing, regression testing, and retesting to ensure product quality throughout various development phases. ➢ Debugged and executed test cases, analyzed results, and identified
defects to ensure optimal application performance.
➢ Conducted cross-browser compatibility testing on platforms like Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge, ensuring a consistent user experience.
➢ Managed the bug lifecycle using JIRA, including defect identification,
tracking, and collaborating with developers for resolution.
➢ Documented and communicated testing progress, bug reports, and
enhancements to ensure alignment and clarity among cross-functional teams.
DECLARATION
I hereby declare that the information provided above is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.
(Bengaluru)
(Praveen)
